verdict.rationale: The README explicitly lists "CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than the total VRAM capacity" as a feature. Community reports independently confirm it: users split models across GPU and CPU to run 70B models on desktops, and tune offload with an N_GPU_LAYERS setting. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the offload controls (layer-count flags, tuning guidance), and evidence that past hybrid-mode limits (a 40-layer cap, single-CPU-core use) are resolved in current versions.
